svg.text: UI conventions — what is not a form row, a node's Details editor, the label width (DESIGN_UI_Conventions.md §3)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
A · Not form rows — they keep ImGui's own shape (Q-C3)
KEPT · a filter bar: each checkbox is an option, its text after the box
Three things stay as they are: a search box (the hint inside it is its label),
a row of filter checkboxes (each one an option, not a field), a row of buttons.
REJECTED · the same bar forced label-first
… a column of rows for what was one line
B · A node's editor in the Blueprint's Details panel (the 'node drawers' — NOT on the canvas)
TODAY · WhenNodeDrawer: label after the control
AFTER · label-first; a group of flags stays in column 2
A field made of several flags (Edges) keeps each flag's text after its box — INSIDE column 2.
The same applies to every node editor (20 drawers) and to popups like 'promote to variable'.
C · The label column: the widest label, but never more than 25 % of the form (Q-C6)
560 px: 25 % = 134 px. The long label is cut with … and its full text is
the tooltip; the short ones keep the column narrow (widest first, cap second).
Starts with weapon raised and ready
320 px: 25 % = 74 px, below the 90 px floor —
The rule, recomputed when the form's
label is measured once per form):
⭐ Labels are written short — a label
that needs the cut is a finding.
